structured_output.summary: The diff implements Date.prototype.setMinutes step by step, in spec order. It reads the [[DateValue]] before the ToNumber calls (step 3 before 4), performs ToNumber on minute, second and millisecond with `?`, and returns NaN early when tv is NaN. It then applies LocalTime, fills in the defaults from SecondFromTime and MillisecondFromTime, and calls MakeDate, MakeTime, UTC, TimeClip and the slot write in order, returning u. No test-shaped branches, no swallowed errors, no fabricated values. The only deviations are cosmetic: the length/NOTE comment block was dropped from the stub and new_target was renamed to _new_target. The four remaining test262 failures come from the test harness calling the unimplemented Date.prototype.setTime, which is an honest not-implemented error and not a defect here.
structured_output.notes_for_next_attempt: No defects found in this change. Minor nit only: the stub's trailing "The length property..." and NOTE comment lines were removed; restoring them as comments would match the ticket's instruction to keep the spec text in the file. The helpers used (support::date::this_time_value, local_time, sec_from_time, make_time, utc, time_clip, set_time_value) were not visible in the diff, so their correctness rests on the build and test262 results.
